policy_yaml:
# Guard policy for custody wallets.
# Every signing request is evaluated here before the signing service sees it.
# A request is signed only when no rule denies or holds it. Deny wins over hold.
version: 1

scope:
  wallets: [hot, warm]
  chains: [ethereum, optimism, arbitrum, base, polygon, avalanche,
           bitcoin, tron, xrpl, solana, near]

intents:
  # Withdrawal intents come from the ledger, signed by the withdrawals service,
  # never from the caller that asks for the signature.
  source: withdrawals-ledger
  match: [destination, asset, amount]
  max_age: 15m

rules:
  - id: no-delegation
    description: Custody wallets never delegate their code or set an authority.
    match: { type: [eip7702_authorization, set_code, set_authority] }
    decision: deny

  - id: intent-required
    description: Every outgoing transfer matches a withdrawal intent.
    match: { type: [transfer, token_transfer] }
    require: intent
    on_missing: deny

  - id: halt
    description: While withdrawals are suspended, nothing leaves a custody wallet.
    match: { flag: withdrawals_suspended }
    decision: deny

  - id: velocity
    description: At most 5% of a hot wallet's balance in any 10 minutes.
    window: 10m
    limit: { share_of_balance: 0.05 }
    on_breach: hold

  - id: fan-out
    description: More than 10 new destinations in 5 minutes needs a second approver.
    window: 5m
    limit: { new_destinations: 10 }
    on_breach: hold

  - id: contract-allowlist
    description: Contract calls only to allowlisted contracts and selectors.
    match: { type: contract_call }
    require: { allowlist: custody-contracts }
    on_missing: hold

approvals:
  hold:
    approvers: 2
    from: [treasury-ops, security-oncall]
    timeout: 30m
    on_timeout: deny

cases.title: An EIP-7702 delegation from a hot wallet
cases.story: The kind of request the signing service received on 29 October: authorize an outside contract to execute on behalf of a hot wallet. Fifty of these were signed.

reasons.message: Custody wallets never delegate their code. Refused before signing, whoever asks.
No withdrawal intent references this request.

cases.title: A transfer no customer asked for
cases.story: A caller with valid service credentials asks for 12,400 ETH to an address that appears in no withdrawal request.

reasons.message: No intent in the withdrawals ledger matches destination, asset and amount.

cases.title: Five XRP wallets emptied in four minutes
cases.story: A burst of payments that would move most of each hot wallet's balance within minutes, as on the XRP Ledger at 20:05 UTC.

reasons.message: 61% of the wallet's balance within 10 minutes; the limit is 5%.

cases.title: Bitcoin split across 19 new addresses
cases.story: One request pays 19 addresses the wallet has never paid before, the pattern of the 18,270 BTC split.

reasons.message: None of the 19 outputs matches a withdrawal intent.
19 new destinations in one request; more than 10 needs a second approver.

cases.title: Signing after withdrawals were suspended
cases.story: Withdrawals are suspended, but a request arrives anyway. On 29 October the delegations kept moving funds after the halt.

reasons.message: Withdrawals are suspended. Nothing leaves a custody wallet until the halt is lifted.

cases.title: A call to a contract nobody approved
cases.story: A contract call from a hot wallet to an address that is not on the custody allowlist.

reasons.message: The contract is not on the custody allowlist. Held for two approvers.

cases.title: A large treasury move with an intent behind it
cases.story: Treasury moves 3,000 BTC to cold storage. The intent matches, but the size breaches the velocity limit, so it waits for two approvers.

reasons.message: 18% of the wallet's balance within 10 minutes; held for two approvers.

cases.title: An ordinary customer withdrawal
cases.story: A customer withdraws 2.5 ETH. Destination, asset and amount match the intent in the ledger, and the wallet is well inside its limits.

reasons.message: Matches withdrawal W-88213-0042: destination, asset and amount agree.
0.04% of balance in the last 10 minutes.
